email.subject: Quick note on Mainline Co's website
email.body:
Hi Jack,

I looked at Mainline Co Plumbing's site. Two things are likely costing you calls: there's no sign of reviews anywhere, so new visitors have no proof you're reliable before they call a competitor instead. And your hours aren't listed, which means someone searching for a plumber right now can't tell if you're open and just moves on.

The page also loads slowly from large, unoptimized images, which pushes people away before they even see your info.

I fix stuff like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough of what I'd change?

Alex
